rounds.text: The market capitalisation of ₹ 20.1 Cr [E2] masks severe structural unprofitability, evidenced by a negative P/E of -4.44x compared to a sector benchmark of 8.99x [E5]. This lack of earnings power translates into a deeply negative ROE of -9.02% against a sector benchmark of 6.69% [E8], alongside a stagnant ROA of 0% versus a sector benchmark of 4.01% [E7]. Operational deterioration is accelerating as trailing twelve-month compounded profit growth collapses by -468% [E16], while compounded sales growth slows dramatically to just 3% over the same period [E15]. Furthermore, price growth exceeds profit growth by a staggering 443%, indicating that market expectations are running dangerously ahead of actual business delivery [E36]. Conceded: the company maintains a low price-to-book ratio of 0.43x against a book value of ₹ 30.0 [E1], a dividend yield of 3.83% [E3], and a multi-year sales uptrend with 3-year compounded growth at 19% [E14].
